body_html:
@johanbove Yeah it is so cool isn't it! I love it. Keeping metadata in your HTML and you can sign in so many places with your domain.

As an FYI it isn't predefined CSS properties. Microformats use the class attributes any HTML element can carry (same way we use this to add CSS selectors) and to get really unnecessarily pedantic you are using XFN, a type of microformats carried in rel attribute.
